# Orangeville Home Renovation — Renovation Services Leads, Orangeville, Ontario

> Connects Orangeville, Ontario homeowners and businesses needing home renovation work with a single vetted, exclusive local contractor. Part of the WeProvideLeads network of local-service lead generation sites.

This site is a lead-generation and referral service, not a contracting company itself. Requests submitted through the contact form are matched with one qualified, exclusive contractor serving the area.

## Services
- Kitchen Renovations: Cabinetry, countertops, layout changes, and full gut renovations.
- Bathroom Renovations: From a fresh vanity and tile to a complete accessible-bathroom rebuild.
- Basement Finishing: Turn unused basement space into a legal, comfortable living area.
- Whole-Home Renovations: Coordinated, multi-room renovations managed under one project timeline.
- Flooring &amp; Interior Finishing: Hardwood, LVP, tile, trim, and paint — the details that finish a space.
- Home Additions: Add square footage with additions that match your home's existing style.

## Service area
Orangeville, Shelburne, Grand Valley, Erin, Mono, Caledon Village
